thread:
kaya_cs: FYI — Customer Acme (Julie) hit a billing sync bug where their trial credits were auto-renewed into a 0-cost promo and then immediately removed. They lost remaining trial balance during a load test. Asking for a one-time extension/reinstatement. Account: acct_12345. cc @matt_billing @joseph_ops

matt_billing: Can you paste the account ID and the timeframe? Did they have a promo code applied or was this auto-granted? Any logs from the credit-service?

kaya_cs: Account acct_12345. Incident window: 2026-02-27 23:50 — 2026-02-28 00:10 UTC. Customer says they applied promo code PKGTRIAL2026 earlier in Feb. Our logs show an auto-renew job ran and then a subsequent sync removed the grant. Snippet from credit-sync log:

```
[2026-02-27T23:59:58Z] credit-sync INFO grant_applied acct=acct_12345 promo=PKGTRIAL2026 amount=50000 id=gr_9f2
[2026-02-27T23:59:59Z] billing-sync WARN fallback_to_zero acct=acct_12345 reason=missing_billing_profile
[2026-02-28T00:00:02Z] credit-sync INFO grant_removed acct=acct_12345 id=gr_9f2 reason=auto_sync_overwrite
```

They were running a short load test and hit a few 429s; retries may have consumed tokens while state was inconsistent. Customer is asking for reinstatement and a short extension window so their e2e tests can finish.

joseph_ops: Thanks — that log looks like the known race where promo grants are created in the promo-service but the billing-profile check happens slightly later and clears grants if profile not found. We can do a manual rollback/grant. Question: how many tokens should we restore? Also, do we want to extend expiry date?

kaya_cs: Customer asked for enough to finish their test — they estimated ~75k tokens. Suggest we restore 100k to be safe and set expiry to 2026-03-31. I'll confirm with Julie once you propose an amount.

acme_julie: Hi team — thanks for the quick triage. We ran a script that generated embeddings + a few large completions; estimate ~60-80k tokens burned. We'd appreciate the 100k restore and extension to end of March. Also can you confirm this won't re-occur? We saw a couple of 429s which caused client retries. :pray:

matt_billing: Policy note: we have a one-time customer-facing grace for platform-induced losses. If it's clearly caused by our sync bug and not customer misuse, billing can approve a manual grant. I'll approve 100k and require CS to tag the account with reason `trial_sync_grace` and close the loop in the support ticket.

joseph_ops: I'll execute the internal grant command now. Command: 

```
internal-grants grant --acct acct_12345 --amt 100000 --unit tokens --reason trial_sync_grace --expiry 2026-03-31
```

Running...

joseph_ops: done — command returned success. Service log:

```
[2026-02-28T00:45:12Z] grants-svc INFO manual_grant acct=acct_12345 amount=100000 granted_by=joseph_ops id=gr_manual_20260228 expiry=2026-03-31
```

billing-bot: Credit grant processed. New balance for acct_12345: 100000 tokens. Expiry: 2026-03-31. Tag applied: trial_sync_grace.

kaya_cs: Confirmed with Julie; she accepts the 100k and the expiry date. I'll update the support ticket with the approval and tag. Please add a short postmortem entry to the infra backlog so we reduce the race. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

acme_julie: Thank you everyone — really appreciate the fast help. That should cover our remaining tests.

matt_billing: I'll mark this as billing-approved and add the policy note to the ticket. We should also add a guard in the sync job to prevent immediate overwrite if grant timestamp < 2m.

kaya_cs: Noted — creating a follow-up in proj-infra. Thread closed once ticket is updated.
